limits: This is the Markdown verdict the GitHub Action posts as its pull request comment (actions/land runs pytxo check --markdown), rendered on a laptop; it was not posted on GitHub.
With no --per-input, the check ran the combined change first, each branch alone after it failed, and the combined change once more; the comment lists the branches first.
Pybench writes both branches itself; no agent wrote them.
It shows the mechanism, not how often it happens in real projects.
Timed on a laptop busy with other work.
